method.unit: One matched A/B pair of fresh processes on one GPU
method.timing_aggregation: Median per process, then median of process medians per arm
method.timing_effect: Geometric mean of paired B/A median ratios, as percent change
method.memory_metric: GIFT device_capacity_report estimate in GiB using allocator reserved peak plus report-time non-PyTorch memory
method.memory_aggregation: Maximum measured call per process, then maximum per arm
method.memory_effect: Arithmetic mean of paired B minus A process maxima, in GiB
method.stability: Compare medians of the first and last halves of measured calls
method.confidence: Two-sided 95% Student-t interval using 16 pair effects and 15 degrees of freedom. Timing uses log(B/A), then converts the estimate and bounds to percent. Intervals assume independent, approximately normal pair effects. Intervals are per metric and have no multiplicity correction.
method.interpretation: Negative effects favor B. Intervals containing zero leave the direction unresolved at this confidence level. Results apply to the measured fixtures and GPUs.

timer_scopes.forward_ms: CUDA event forward span including queue gaps
timer_scopes.backward_ms: CUDA event backward span including queue gaps
timer_scopes.wall_ms: Host elapsed time from submission start through CUDA synchronization
timer_scopes.host_submission_ms: Host elapsed time through final CUDA event recording
timer_scopes.wall_drain_ms: Host elapsed time in final CUDA synchronization
